up: Retrieve activity details for compound CHEMBL1173655 and all its salt/derivative forms. Use molecule_hierarchy to find the parent molregno for CHEMBL1173655 and all child molregno values where parent_molregno matches that parent, ensuring both the parent and all salts are included. Filter activities to standard_type = 'IC50' and standard_units = 'nM'. Filter assays to target CHEMBL203. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles, compound_records for compound_key, and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Return exactly these columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH related_mols AS (
  SELECT molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy
  WHERE parent_molregno = (
    SELECT COALESCE(parent_molregno, molregno)
    FROM molecule_hierarchy
    WHERE molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655')
  )
)
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM related_mols rm
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON rm.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON rm.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN activities a ON rm.molregno = a.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
WHERE
  a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
